text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty ALERT: high GPU memory pressure on pool 'dedicated-gpu-eu-west-3' (node-group: gpu-pool-3). Auto-escalation triggered. stack: inference-runtime-v2. Summary: sudden increase in per-request KV cache usage -> sustained CUDA alloc failures. Link: https://pd.redwood.example/incidents/INC-20286

pagerduty: Incident INC-20286 created (P1). Notifying oncall.

Sam (oncall): ack'd. I'm looking.

Maya (infra): seeing repeated `cudaErrorMemoryAllocation` in driver logs on nvidia0-3. Node ids: gnode-34,g-35,g-36. Kernel logs attached below.

Maya (infra): logs:```
[2026-03-15T09:07:12Z] inference-runtime pid=4821: cuda: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
[2026-03-15T09:07:12Z] inference-runtime pid=4821: model=session-abc: kvcache growth to 6.8GB -> failure
[2026-03-15T09:07:13Z] kernel: NVRM: GPU at PCI:0000:65:00.0: GPU has fallen off the bus
```

Devon (runtime): confirmed auto-shedder kicked in but there's a backlog. Metrics show per-node GPU mem usage at 98-100% for 4m+. Autoscale didn't add more nodes because reserved capacity cap hit.

Sam (oncall): can we drain one of the noisy nodes and failover sessions?

Maya (infra): starting cordon/drain on gnode-36. Running:```bash
kubectl cordon gnode-36
kubectl drain gnode-36 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=5m
```

Maya (infra): also bumping pool-capacity temp to allow 2 extra nodes (quota ok for eu-west).

Devon (runtime): triggering fallback to CPU for new sessions to avoid immediate OOMs. Patch going out to route policy:```json
{
  "route": "legacy-cpu-fallback",
  "threshold": "gpu_alloc_failures>5m"
}
```

Sam (oncall): good. Notify product/solutions if customers see 502s. Any customer-visible impact yet?

Devon (runtime): alerting shows ~1.8% of requests to hosted endpoint `v1/generate` returned 502 or timed out in the last 3m. Top effected customer: "AcmePayments" (spike in retries). Latency p95 for cpu fallback now 1.8s.

Sam (oncall): noted. Posting incident notes to #incidents, some customers might open support tickets.

pagerduty: INC-20286 acknowledged by Sam (oncall). Escalation to infra in 5m if not resolved.

Maya (infra): drain complete on gnode-36. Evicted ~18 active pods; runtime resumed warm starts. Node remains cordoned.

Devon (runtime): KV cache eviction patch applied (soft-limit 5GB per-session). Warmup restored. Error rate falling: 502s down to 0.4% over last 2m.

Sam (oncall): thumbs. Anything else for immediate fix?

Maya (infra): I requested a temporary capacity bump (2 nodes) and increased the allowed pool autoscale cap. Cloud team approved. New nodes provisioning now (~3m).

Leah (next oncall): I'm coming up to speed. TL;DR?

Sam (oncall): TL;DR: sudden KV cache growth caused sustained GPU OOMs on gpu-pool-3, auto-shedder reduced throughput, some 502s for customers (~2% peak). We cordoned/drained one noisy node, applied soft KV limits, triggered CPU fallback for new sessions, and requested 2 extra nodes. Current status: error rate back to ~0.4% and trending down; provisioning in progress.

Leah (next oncall): ack. I'll monitor for the next 30m and follow up with a brief incident note. Can you paste the runbook link for handoff?

Sam (oncall): runbook: https://redwood.docs/incidents/gpu-memory-pressure-runbook. Key runbook steps: check `nvidia-smi -q`, look for MIG/driver resets, cordon+drain noisy nodes, soft-kv limits, temp capacity bump, and customer impact assessment.

Devon (runtime): also leaving here the diagnostics command we used:```bash
kubectl logs -n inference -l app=inference-runtime --tail=200 | grep -i "cudaMalloc\|kvcache\|OOM"
rdctl node metrics gnode-36 --since 10m
```

Sam (oncall): leaving handoff: assigned to Leah for monitoring; please escalate back to infra if 502 > 1% sustained for 5m or new cuda alloc failures appear.

Leah (next oncall): got it. I'll update INC-20286 with notes and close when stable for 30m. :wave::eyes:

incident-bot: Reminder: incident auto-escalation timer paused (ack). Next auto-escalate at 2026-03-15T10:05:00Z if not updated.

Sam (oncall): adding customer impact tag: partial_outage. Notifying Customer Success to proactively reach out to top hit customers.

Maya (infra): follow-up action: schedule kernel/driver patch on nodes gnode-34/35/36 for changelist that improves fragmentation handling.

Leah (next oncall): will do postmortem if we need one. For now monitoring.

pagerduty: INC-20286 updated: status=investigating, assigned=Leah.
